lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form IV) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَأَلْهَمَهَا is in the derivative form: ألْهَمَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ﻫ/ﻡ   l–h–m gulping, glutton; inspiration, to inspire; notable person; fast horse; vast army. Of this root, only ألْهَمَ ʾalhama occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ألْهَمَ ʾalhama [v. IV, doubly trans.] to instil something into, to inspire

(91:8) فَأَلْهَمَهَا‏ ‏فُجُورَهَا‏ ‏وَتَقْوَاهَا‏so He instilled into it [the capacity for] its lewdness (or, rebellion) and its piety.
